name: The Gift of Healing
body:
You have a knack for treating wounds, illnesses and injuries.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is the healer, or a god of healing

Benefit: You get a +2 divine bonus on all Heal checks and never suffer a penalty to Heal checks when you do not have a healer’s kit.
